picks.what: The Tapiola garden city, aerial photograph
picks.why: dated aerial of Tapiola, the planned garden city Espoo is known for; center pool and buildings at top

notes: Espoo has no historic center or skyline; the other P6 hits are an industrial area, a highway interchange and a power plant. #6 is a fallback suburban view (1080 px tall); a modern view of Tapiola or Otaniemi would be better. #1–2 are a single school building.
